author: Ed Crocker
description:
Critically acclaimed and award-winning fantasy author R J Barker has been enchanting readers for years with the respective trilogies The Wounded Kingdom, The Tide Child and The Forsaken. We recently caught up with him to discuss his new fantasy epic Mortedant’s Peril, reading the thoughts of the recently dead, how to make old fantasy ideas […]

The post INTERVIEW: with author R.J. Barker appeared first on Grimdark Magazine.
title: INTERVIEW: with author R.J. Barker
